info.name: ClassFlow API
info.description:
Endpoints for the ClassFlow school management API.

Before testing: set the collection variable `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3000), then run **Login** or **Signup** first — they auto-save the access token into `{{accessToken}}`.

Role notes:
- `/api/centers/**` requires SUPERADMIN.
- `/api/students/**` and `/api/teachers/**` writes require SUPERADMIN/ADMIN/MANAGER/RECEPTIONIST.
- For writes/by-id on students & teachers, non-SUPERADMINs use their token center automatically; SUPERADMINs must add `?centerId=<id>` (also set the `centerId` variable).

request.description: Public. Returns service status and uptime.
Public (rate-limited). Creates a RECEPTIONIST user. `centerId` optional — defaults to the first active center. Returns 201 with accessToken + user, and sets the refreshToken HttpOnly cookie.
Public (rate-limited). Returns 200 with accessToken + user, and sets the refreshToken HttpOnly cookie. `centerId` optional — used to disambiguate when the same username exists in multiple centers.
Public (rate-limited). Reads the `refreshToken` cookie sent by a previous login/signup. Rotates the token and returns 200 with a new accessToken + refreshed cookie.
Requires Bearer token + refresh cookie. Revokes the current refresh token. Returns 204.
Requires Bearer token. Revokes all refresh tokens for the user. Returns 204.
Requires Bearer token. Returns the current user.
Requires SUPERADMIN. Returns paginated centers.

Requires SUPERADMIN. Creates a center. Returns 201 with the created center.

Requires SUPERADMIN. Creates a center user. role optional (default ADMIN); allowed: ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT, RECEPTIONIST. Returns 201 with { id, username, role, centerId }.
